Name: Ship HP
Description: Read the current Gummi ship HP, including fractional recovery.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only. Values become unavailable when Gummi module ownership is lost.

Evidence.Finding: Authoritative float HP is at PLAYER_STATE+8 (player+0x578).
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

Name: Maximum ship HP
Description: Read maximum HP calculated from the selected ship and its installed parts.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only. Values become unavailable when Gummi module ownership is lost.

Evidence.Finding: Loadout aggregation initializes int32 maximum HP at PLAYER_STATE+12.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

Name: Heal ship
Description: Recover a positive amount of HP on the living Gummi ship. The amount cannot exceed its current maximum HP. Close the pause menu before applying.
RestoreBehavior: One-time action. Disconnecting does not roll back the result.

Evidence.Finding: Native recovery takes PLAYER_STATE in RCX and float amount in XMM1; clamps HP and sets its healing event.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

Name: Refill ship HP
Description: Restore the living Gummi ship to its current maximum HP. A ship that is dead or rebirthing is excluded.
RestoreBehavior: One-time action. Disconnecting does not roll back the result.

Evidence.Finding: Calls the native healer with missing HP. Skips the call when already full because native zero means one HP.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

Name: Mission score
Description: Read the native mission score. Its low digit also records up to nine damage events.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only. Values become unavailable when Gummi module ownership is lost.

Evidence.Finding: Global uint32 score RVA72B130; hit processing increments only its ones digit.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

Name: Add mission points
Description: Add points in multiples of 10, preserving the recorded damage digit. Native limits and the mission score lock apply. Later rewards and saves can reflect this change.
RestoreBehavior: One-time action. Disconnecting does not roll back the result.

Evidence.Finding: Calls the native score adder with ECX=int amount; ignores undefined RAX. Rank and reward processing consumes this score.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

Name: Recorded damage events
Description: Read the score's damage digit. It stops increasing at nine events.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only. Values become unavailable when Gummi module ownership is lost.

Evidence.Finding: Pending hit processing adds one to score only when score%10 is less than nine.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA decompilation and critical ABI assembly; isolated guard tests passed. Live Gummi validation is pending.

RestoreBehavior: Read-only. Values become unavailable when Gummi module ownership is lost.

Evidence.Finding: Current level is int32 RVA72B2C4; the native path caps at30 and applies mission-specific hit penalties.
